tasks.title: Render issue description and comments as Markdown
tasks.description: Replace the plain pre-wrapped rendering of issue descriptions and comments with a shared Markdown renderer on Issue Detail Page. The renderer should use the existing react-markdown dependency, add minimal GitHub-flavored Markdown support if needed, and support common Markdown structures without changing edit, comment submission, or delete flows.
acceptanceCriteria: Issue descriptions render Markdown headings, paragraphs, ordered and unordered lists, emphasis, strikethrough, explicit links, bare URL autolinks, blockquotes, horizontal rules, inline code, and fenced code blocks instead of exposing raw Markdown markers
Issue comments render Markdown content with the same core formatting support as descriptions
Comment timestamps and delete actions remain visible next to rendered comments
Existing issue edit, comment submit, and comment delete flows keep using the same mutations and remain functional
Any new package dependency is limited to the Markdown parser support needed for strikethrough and bare URL autolinks and is recorded in package.json
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Consumes react-markdown and current issue/comment body strings; produces the reusable renderer used by later styling and collapse work. Add remark-gfm only if needed for required GFM behavior.

tasks.title: Style Markdown code for readability
tasks.description: Enhance the shared Issue Detail Markdown renderer so inline code and fenced code blocks have clear visual treatment. The styling should use the existing gray palette, monospaced font, rounded corners, compact spacing, and horizontal scrolling for long code block lines.
acceptanceCriteria: Inline code has a distinct gray background, monospaced font, rounded corners, and compact padding
Fenced code blocks have a distinct gray background, monospaced font, rounded corners, padding, and horizontal scrolling for long lines
Code styling is applied consistently in both descriptions and comments
Markdown content still uses compact text-sm page styling
No syntax-highlighting package is added
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Consumes the shared Markdown renderer produced by T-001 and specializes its code element rendering; this task should not add any additional dependencies.

tasks.title: Add collapsible long description behavior
tasks.description: Add local expand/collapse behavior for the rendered issue description so long content is collapsed by default around the 600px threshold. The control should make the full Markdown content accessible without changing comment rendering or persisted issue data.
acceptanceCriteria: Long issue descriptions are initially constrained to about 600px height on Issue Detail Page
An explicit expand control reveals the full rendered description
An explicit collapse control returns the description to the constrained height
Markdown structure and code blocks remain rendered by the shared renderer when collapsed or expanded
Comments remain fully expanded and do not gain per-comment collapse controls
Expansion state is local UI state and is not persisted or sent to the API
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Consumes the Markdown-rendered and styled description produced by T-001 and T-002, then wraps it with local collapse UI.

tasks.title: Verify Markdown rendering and collapse behavior
tasks.description: Add or update frontend tests that exercise the Issue Detail Page Markdown rendering, code styling, and long-description collapse behavior. Tests should verify user-visible output rather than implementation details and should protect existing comment actions from regressions where practical.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests cover Markdown rendering for issue descriptions, including headings, lists, strikethrough, bare URL autolinks, inline code, and fenced code blocks
Tests cover Markdown rendering for comments
Tests cover the description expand/collapse interaction for long content
Tests confirm existing comment submission or deletion behavior is not broken where existing test utilities support it
Relevant tests pass
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Consumes the rendering, styling, and collapse behavior from T-001 through T-003; may adjust the output path to match existing test organization.
